name: INDIVIDUAL_SLA_V1
steps: load SlaInput for exact SR and current valid classification for explicit as_of_utc
if current classification absent return classification_state=unclassified and no policy tier results; do not conflate with missing Report Date
resolve classified CPL -> active/historical-readable Contract -> current accepted policy revision; current live calculation uses the current accepted policy revision even when SR predates it
if accepted lifecycle is Cancelled return calculation_state=cancelled_excluded; preserve classification/source chronology but emit no cohort-eligible tier results
if accepted Report Date missing return calculation_state=missing_report_date and no elapsed value; never substitute import/current/file time
require recognized supported severity; unresolved severity returns severity_unresolved without guessing a default

resolve endpoint: for current eligible active SR use as_of_utc; for currently eligible Resolved/Closed use the first accepted effective Resolved/Closed endpoint supplied by ticket/source authority; never use recording/import time or a later Closed to extend an earlier Resolved endpoint
obtain cumulative accepted source-reported suspension ExactDuration only; do not infer additional suspension from status, planned end or inactivity
compute raw elapsed rational seconds = endpoint - ReportDate - suspension using common denominator; clamp negative result to exact zero
for every current policy tier matching severity compare elapsed <= maximum duration by integer cross multiplication
active SR tier state is active_within when inclusive comparison passes else active_exceeded; eligible terminal Resolved/Closed tier state is terminal_met when it passes else terminal_exceeded
compute input_fingerprint from SR internal id/source input token/current classification event/CPL/current policy revision/severity/as_of_utc and exact endpoint/suspension evidence refs
suspension_warnings: Suspend Planned End Date is not subtracted from elapsed time
when accepted status=Customer Agreed Suspend and a valid future planned end exists, expose active suspension context and optional ending-soon condition using configured noncontractual threshold
missing/expired planned end while status reports suspended yields separate source inconsistency warning
later blank/zero cumulative suspension conflicting with accepted nonzero history must have been resolved by source-review owner before this calculator consumes the accepted value
rules: all authoritative duration/policy comparisons are exact rational/integer operations
passing or failing an individual tier is not itself cohort percentage success/failure
ResolveBy and Resolve By Suspend never enter the calculation
Objective/Task scheduling timezone never enters the calculation
